question: Compare the FY24 dividend payout ratio of Coca-Cola (KO) to that of its competitors and rank in order from highest to lowest.
model_answer:
Using the standard **FY24 payout ratio = dividends per share ÷ diluted EPS (GAAP)**, and the common US-listed beverage peer group:

| Rank | Company | FY24 DPS | FY24 diluted EPS | Payout ratio |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | **Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP)** | $0.89 | $1.05 | **84.8%** |
| 2 | **Coca-Cola (KO)** | $1.94 | $2.46 | **78.9%** |
| 3 | **PepsiCo (PEP)** | $5.33 | $6.95 | **76.7%** |
| 4 | **Monster Beverage (MNST)** | $0.00 | $1.49 | **0.0%** |

**Bottom line:** Coca-Cola’s FY24 payout ratio was **about 78.9%**, ranking **second-highest** in this group—**above PepsiCo but below Keurig Dr Pepper**. Monster ranks last because it pays no dividend.

**Important caveat:** KDP’s GAAP payout is inflated by a roughly **$718 million impairment** and **$225 million GHOST-related charge** in FY24, which depressed GAAP EPS. On **adjusted EPS of $1.92**, KDP’s payout would be only **46.4%**. On adjusted/comparable EPS, the ranking becomes:

1. **KO:** $1.94 / $2.88 = **67.4%**  
2. **PEP:** $5.33 / $8.16 = **65.3%**  
3. **KDP:** $0.89 / $1.92 = **46.4%**  
4. **MNST:** **0.0%**

So on a **reported GAAP basis**, KDP is highest; on an **underlying/adjusted basis**, Coca-Cola is highest.

**Sources:**  
- Coca-Cola FY24 dividends per share: [KO year-end dividend table](https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/stock-info/year-end); FY24 EPS: [KO Q4/FY24 release](https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1128/coca-cola-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results)  
- PepsiCo FY24 DPS and EPS: [PepsiCo FY24 10-K/Q4 release](https://investor.pepsico.com/docs/pepsico-5v9wci20/media/Files/investors/q4-2024-earnings-release.pdf)  
- KDP FY24 DPS, EPS, adjusted EPS: [KDP FY24 earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1418135/000141813525000011/ex991-keurigdrpepperreport.htm) and [KDP 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1418135/000141813525000013/kdp-20241231.htm)  
- Monster FY24 EPS and no dividend: [Monster FY24 release](https://investors.monsterbevcorp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/monster-beverage-reports-2024-fourth-quarter-and-full-year)
judge_reason: Only KO matches; KDP and PEP differ, KHC and SJM are omitted, and conflicting stated ratios trigger contradiction.
